## Context

F47 is approved as research. The legacy ticket wordlist is byte-stable but lacks an established upstream revision or license. The import commit names Digital Service Orchestra without recording a source or terms.

## Plan

- Record the current digest, line count, byte size, and introduction commit for src/rebar/_engine/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt.
- Examine primary-source history and upstream candidates.
- Record the canonical location, retrieval date, source revision, comparison method, and result for every source examined.
- Classify provenance evidence as proven, disproven, or unresolved.
- Classify license evidence as proven, disproven, or unresolved.
- Record supported repository corrections in a separate proposal that requires approval before implementation.
- Do not edit repository files.
- Do not make an attribution or license claim without primary-source proof.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The ticket records the SHA-256 digest of the legacy wordlist.
- [x] The ticket records the line count of the legacy wordlist.
- [x] The ticket records the byte size of the legacy wordlist.
- [x] The ticket records the introduction commit of the legacy wordlist.
- [x] Every primary source examined has a canonical location.
- [x] Every primary source examined has a retrieval date.
- [x] Every primary source examined identifies a source revision when one exists.
- [x] Every primary source examined records its comparison method.
- [x] Every primary source examined records its comparison result.
- [x] The conclusion classifies provenance evidence.
- [x] The conclusion classifies license evidence.
- [x] No attribution claim is made without primary-source proof.
- [x] No license claim is made without primary-source proof.
- [x] Any repository correction is proposed separately for approval. No correction is supported by the available evidence.
- [x] The repository worktree remains unchanged.

## Verification

- `shasum -a 256 src/rebar/_engine/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt`
- `wc -l -c src/rebar/_engine/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt`
- `git log --follow --format="%H %aI %s" -- src/rebar/_engine/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt`
- `git diff --exit-code`
- Inspect each recorded primary source for its canonical location, retrieval date, source revision when available, comparison method, and comparison result.
- Inspect the conclusion to confirm that unresolved evidence remains unresolved.
